card.name: Cross-references to label sections
card.fires_on: The last piece of a section name inside a "see ..." cross-reference, such as WARNINGS, PRECAUTIONS or CONTRAINDICATIONS. It also fires on "below" in "see ... below".

modes.label: Section name in see-reference
modes.description: The ending of WARNINGS, PRECAUTIONS or CONTRAINDICATIONS inside parentheses after "see".
modes.example: (see WARN<<INGS>> ). Concomitant administration with strong C

modes.label: The word below
modes.description: "below" at the end of a pointer to another entry or section.
modes.example: For sildenafil and tadalafil, see also Urologic Drugs<< below>>. Bosentan Guanfacine

card.writes: It pushes the word "below" (and its Chinese equivalents), as if finishing a pointer to a section further down.
card.plain: It spots the end of a "see WARNINGS" or "see below" pointer to another part of the label.
